subject: Does geom_rect only work with "low" numbers?

messages.author: 4bd1e087b45f3e85
messages.subject: Does geom_rect only work with "low" numbers?
parts:
Hello,

maybe I do a very stupid mistake again and again but ...

I have problems with geom_rect. I have 2 test sets - df and huz. Only df works. Principally I do not see a difference. Does geom_rect only work with low numbers?

> df
  eins zwei drei
1    1    3    1
2    9   13    2
3   20   26    3
4   40   50    4
> dput(df)
structure(list(eins = c(1, 9, 20, 40), zwei = c(3, 13, 26, 50
), drei = c(1, 2, 3, 4)), .Names = c("eins", "zwei", "drei"), row.names = c(NA,
-4L), class = "data.frame")

This works:
> ggplot (df)+ geom_rect(aes (xmin=eins, xmax=zwei, ymin=0, ymax=drei))


> huz
         s        e p
1  5390998  5391923 8
2 11088023 11088523 7
> dput(huz)
structure(list(s = c(5390998, 11088023), e = c(5391923, 11088523
), p = c(8, 7)), .Names = c("s", "e", "p"), row.names = c(NA,
-2L), class = "data.frame")

This does not work:
> ggplot (huz)+ geom_rect(aes(xmin=s, xmax=e,ymin=0,ymax=p))

Please give me a hint. 

Thanks Hermann

This is a computation of the width of your rectangles in relation to
the width of the plotting region:

with(huz,(e-s)/diff(range(c(s,e))))

The wider of the two rectangles is less than 0.2% of the width of the
plotting region -- less than one pixel ...

They're there -- it's just that the rectangles are very, very skinny. If you add an outline, you can see them:

huz <- structure(list(s = c(5390998, 11088023), e = c(5391923, 11088523), p = c(8, 7)), .Names = c("s", "e", "p"), row.names = c(NA,  -2L), class = "data.frame")

 ggplot (huz)+ geom_rect(aes(xmin=s, xmax=e,ymin=0,ymax=p), colour="black")
